name: rsi2-nifty50
title: RSI(2) mean reversion on NIFTY 50 names
description: Swing, delivery (CNC). Buy at the next open when a stock above its 200-day average closes with a 2-day RSI under 10. Sell at the next open after a close above its 5-day average, or after 10 sessions. A 3 ATR(14) protective stop, because every order in this pack has one.
references: Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez, Short Term Trading Strategies That Work (2008)
